sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: Every four make a heart. Ordered as in Zelda Dungeon's list.

items.name: Forsaken Fortress jail
items.area: Room with the map, bottom floor
items.howTo: Step on the switch behind the barrels in the corner to open the jail cell, and open the chest inside.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #1. Reachable on the first visit, and again later.

items.name: Killer Bees hide-and-seek
items.area: Outside Mrs. Marie's School of Joy
items.howTo: Take up Ivan's challenge and catch all four Killer Bees: behind a bush left of the school's arch, behind Tott's stone, behind the Bomb Shop, and up the tree by the postbox (roll into it).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #2.

items.name: Sinking Ships
items.area: Salvatore's shop, across from the School of Joy
items.howTo: Pay Salvatore 10 Rupees and sink all three squids within 24 shots.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #3. Win again for Treasure Chart 7, and win with under 20 shots for Treasure Chart 23. Zelda Wiki calls the game Squid-Hunt.

items.name: Pawprint Isle ChuChu cave
items.howTo: Crawl into the dome in the middle of the island, drop down the hole and fight through the Red ChuChus to the chest at the end.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #4.

items.name: Letter from Baito's mother
items.howTo: Sort 25 letters in one round of Mail Sorting for Baito, then post the Note to Mom he gives you. His mother's reply arrives in a postbox.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #5.

items.name: Letter from the Rito Chieftain
items.howTo: Check a postbox after getting Farore's Pearl; the Rito Chieftain's letter holds the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #6.

items.name: Five-Star Isles: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 33 near Five-Star Isles (G7), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #7. Treasure Chart 33 is in Charts.

items.name: Five-Star Isles submarine
items.howTo: Board the submarine, defeat the Bokoblins and Keese to drop the ladder, and open the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #8.

items.name: Angular Isles: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 15 near Angular Isles (G5), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #9. Treasure Chart 15 is in Charts.

items.name: Angular Isles summit
items.howTo: Climb onto the largest isle and push and pull its blocks to make steps up to the chest on top.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #10.

items.name: Headstone Island summit
items.howTo: Feed a Hyoi Pear to a seagull, fly it to the piece on top of the island to grab it, then switch back to Link.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #11.

items.name: Diamond Steppe Island: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 23 near Diamond Steppe Island (F1), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #12. Treasure Chart 23 is in Charts.

items.name: Needle Rock Isle chest
items.howTo: Feed a Hyoi Pear to a seagull and fly it into the switch at the top of the isle to put out the flames around the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #13.

items.name: Greatfish Isle ledge
items.area: Ledge north-west of the small island
items.howTo: Climb the small island, turn the wind with the Wind's Requiem and float north-west to the ledge with the Deku Leaf.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #14.

items.name: Six-Eye Reef submarine
items.howTo: Board the submarine, defeat the three Moblins to drop the ladder, and open the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #15.

items.name: Orca's training
items.howTo: Accept Orca's training and land 500 hits on him.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #16.

items.name: Stone Watcher Island lookout
items.howTo: Destroy the cannons on the lookout platform by the island with the boat's cannon, then climb up and open the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #17.

items.name: Tingle Island Big Octo
items.area: North of the island, where the seagulls circle
items.howTo: Destroy all twelve eyes of the Big Octo with arrows, the Boomerang or the cannon, then haul up its treasure with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #18. Take a pictograph of a Big Octo for the Nintendo Gallery before the last one is gone.

items.name: Spectacle Island cannon game
items.howTo: Pay 50 Rupees by day and sink all five barrels with ten cannonballs.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #19. Win again for Treasure Chart 17.

items.name: Windfall Auction
items.howTo: Win the Piece of Heart in one of the nightly auctions; bring plenty of Rupees.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #20. Wind Waker HD's auction also has the Swift Sail.

items.name: Anton and Linda
items.howTo: Show Anton a colour pictograph of Linda. Come back the next day: Linda, now at the Cafe Bar with Anton, gives you the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #21. Needs the Deluxe Picto Box (GameCube: bring Lenzo a Forest Firefly).

items.name: Crescent Moon Island: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 11 near Crescent Moon Island (A5), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #22. Treasure Chart 11 is in Charts.

items.name: Seven-Star Isles Big Octo
items.howTo: Destroy all twelve eyes of the Big Octo, then haul up its treasure with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #23.

items.name: Letter from Hoskit's girlfriend
items.howTo: Give Hoskit 20 Golden Feathers. His girlfriend's thank-you letter arrives in a postbox.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #24.

items.name: Bird-Man Contest
items.howTo: Fly past the goal line with the Deku Leaf. Turn the wind to blow along the course and ride the updrafts; the double Magic Meter helps.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #25.

items.name: Bomb Island cave
items.area: Under the rock in the middle
items.howTo: Blow up the rock in the middle of the island and clear the cave below to reach the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #26.

items.name: Forest Haven: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 31 near Forest Haven (F6), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #27. Treasure Chart 31 is in Charts.

items.name: Three-Eye Reef: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 38 near Three-Eye Reef (D1), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #28. Treasure Chart 38 is in Charts.

items.name: Star Island cave
items.howTo: Blow up the boulder, drop into the cave and defeat its enemies to make the chest appear.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #29.

items.name: Decorating Windfall
items.howTo: Put 14 decorations from Zunari's shop on the outdoor spots around town (3 by the bench, 2 at Zunari's, 1 by the potion shop, 2 on the ledge opposite it and 6 on the main gate), then talk to the man on the bench.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #30. Each Traveling Merchant trade adds a decoration to Zunari's stock (see Side Quests).

items.name: Beedle's special shop
items.howTo: Buy it for 950 Rupees at the masked Beedle's shop ship by Rock Spire Isle.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #31. The same shop sells Treasure Chart 4 and a Bottle.

items.name: Rock Spire Isle warships
items.howTo: Sink the two warships by the isle with the cannon and haul up their treasure; one holds the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #32.

items.name: Southern Fairy Island: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 4 near Southern Fairy Island (F4), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #33. Treasure Chart 4 is in Charts.

items.name: Pawprint Isle: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 30 near Pawprint Isle (B5), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #34. Treasure Chart 30 is in Charts.

items.name: Shop Guru Statue trade
items.howTo: Finish the Traveling Merchants' trading chain and trade the Shop Guru Statue to the merchant at Greatfish Isle.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #35. The chain is in Side Quests (Traveling Merchants).

items.name: Withered Trees
items.howTo: Water all eight Korok saplings with Forest Water from Forest Haven; the last one gives the piece. Forest Water turns ordinary after 20 minutes (30 in Wind Waker HD), so refill it as you go.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #36. Each tree is in Side Quests.

items.name: Lighting the lighthouse
items.howTo: Turn on the windmill (switch up the ladder behind Salvatore's game, wind blowing north), ride it to the top at night and shoot a Fire Arrow into the light. Kreeb gives you the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #37.

items.name: Islet chest by the Bomb Shop
items.howTo: Once the lighthouse is lit, glide with the Deku Leaf to the chest on the islet near the Bomb Shop; it opens only at night.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #38.

items.name: Maggie and Moe's letters
items.howTo: Post Maggie's Letter to Moe, come back after a day, then get the Moblin's Letter from Quill at the Cafe Bar and give it to Maggie.
items.after: After the second visit to the Forsaken Fortress
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #39.

items.name: Rock Spire Isle: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 2 near Rock Spire Isle (C2), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #40. Treasure Chart 2 is in Charts.

items.name: Rose's big pig
items.area: Patch of soil past the bridge
items.howTo: Carry the big black pig over the bridge to the other half of the island and drop All-Purpose Bait on the dark patch of soil; the pig digs up the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #41. Zelda Wiki says the big pig needs the Power Bracelets; Zelda Dungeon lists only the bait.

items.name: Bomb Island: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 20 near Bomb Island (E6), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #42. Treasure Chart 20 is in Charts.

items.name: Thorned Fairy Island: sunken treasure
items.howTo: Open Treasure Chart 5 near Thorned Fairy Island (D7), sail into the pillar of light and haul up the chest with the Grappling Hook.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #43. Treasure Chart 5 is in Charts.

items.name: Savage Labyrinth floor 50
items.area: Under the stone head on the hill
items.howTo: Lift the stone head with the Power Bracelets and fight down all 50 floors of the Savage Labyrinth; the chest at the bottom has the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's #44. Zelda Dungeon's #44 is the Wind Waker HD location: there the bottom chest holds the Hero's Charm, and this piece is salvaged at Two-Eye Reef with Treasure Chart 46. The Japanese GameCube release has a Piece of Heart under Link's house instead; this is the North American and European one.

items.name: Gohma (Dragon Roost Cavern)
items.howTo: Defeat Gohma at the end of Dragon Roost Cavern.

items.name: Kalle Demos (Forbidden Woods)
items.howTo: Defeat Kalle Demos at the end of Forbidden Woods.

items.name: Gohdan (Tower of the Gods)
items.howTo: Defeat Gohdan at the end of Tower of the Gods.

items.name: Helmaroc King (Forsaken Fortress)
items.howTo: Defeat the Helmaroc King at the top of the Forsaken Fortress, on the second visit.

items.name: Jalhalla (Earth Temple)
items.howTo: Defeat Jalhalla at the end of Earth Temple.

items.name: Molgera (Wind Temple)
items.howTo: Defeat Molgera at the end of Wind Temple.
